preconditions.description: The input contains at least the header line, the initial string line, and m operation lines.
The integer n matches the length of the initial string s.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= current_len and len(c) == 1 for l, r, c, current_len in zip(op_ranges, op_chars, op_lengths))
preconditions.description: Each operation specifies valid 1-based indices l and r within the current string length, and a single character c.

postconditions.description: The output is the string formed by concatenating the characters remaining after all operations.

postconditions.expression: final_chars == [ch for ch, idx in initial_pairs if not any(op['l'] <= idx <= op['r'] and ch == op['c'] for op in operations)]
postconditions.description: A character from the initial string remains in the output if and only if it was never removed by any operation targeting its original 1-based index and matching its character value.
